resale_co.name: Certificate of Municipal Compliance (Residential Resale or Tenant), for smoke and CO detectors and Certificate of Occupancy
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of South Plainfield Building Department
resale_co.lead_time: Certificates are generated within 2 business days after the inspection; do not schedule the closing until the certificate is issued and all open permits and violations are cleared
requirements: Smoke detectors on each habitable level, on or within 6 inches of the ceiling (not in corners), and within 10 feet of the farthest bedroom door
10-year sealed battery smoke detectors; homes built after 1977 with AC or interwired detectors must keep that type; smoke detectors expire after 10 years
CO detectors near all bedrooms, no more than 10 feet from the farthest bedroom door (not inside a bedroom unless there is also one in the hall)
Alarm systems need annunciators within 10 feet of bedrooms and on each level; notify the alarm company before the test

2A-10B:C fire extinguisher, 10 lb. or less, within 10 feet of the kitchen in the path of egress, mounted with the maker's bracket, top no more than 5 feet above the floor (as printed on the June 2023 form)
Sump pump area open for inspection; sump pumps must not discharge into the sanitary sewer
Water heater/boiler discharge valve and any fire sprinkler system are checked

All open permits closed before the inspection; work found done without permits (pools, spas, decks, sheds, garage conversions, basement work, wood stoves, furnace or water heater replacement, central A/C, oil to gas, tank removal) carries a minimum $250 penalty
House Evaluation form: finished basement, A/C, furnace or boiler, generator, sump pump, water heater, deck, shed, pool and radon system (original or replaced)
Inspection may be refused if the property has health or safety issues; corrective action falls on the seller

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Certificate of Municipal Compliance packet (Inspection Request and House Evaluation forms) and submit it in person at the Building Department, 2480 Plainfield Avenue, with a check or money order payable to Borough of South Plainfield. Inspections are held 9:00 am to 12:00 pm, Monday to Friday. The certificate can be picked up or mailed.

resale_co.notes: South Plainfield combines the state smoke/CO certificate and a Borough resale check in one Building Department 'Certificate of Municipal Compliance (Residential Resale or Tenant)'. The form is subtitled 'Certificate of Occupancy', tells sellers not to schedule the closing until it is issued, checks open permits, unpermitted work and sump pumps, and includes a House Evaluation form, so it is recorded as a required town certificate. No Borough ordinance text was found online to confirm the local requirement (the code on ecode360 could not be opened), so confidence is medium. The PDF is a scan: page 1 is marked 'revised June 22, 2023' while the file name is dated 02-25-2025. The inspection-request email on the Building Department page (schedulemyinspection@southplainfieldnj.com) is used as the office email; the form itself says applications must be submitted in person. The same certificate is used for new tenants.

requirements: Smoke detectors on each habitable level and within 10 feet of the farthest bedroom door; 10-year sealed battery units unless the home has AC or interwired detectors (homes built after 1977 must keep that type); detectors expire after 10 years
CO detectors within 10 feet of the farthest bedroom door
Alarm system annunciators within 10 feet of bedrooms and on each level

The June 2023 form still requires a 2A-10B:C extinguisher (10 lb. or less, within 10 feet of the kitchen, mounted, top no higher than 5 feet); P.L.2025, c.19 removed the state extinguisher requirement, so confirm with the Building Department

fire_cert.notes: The state LEA registry lists the South Plainfield Fire Department (code F) as the fire code enforcing agency, with Fire Marshal/Fire Official Michael Pellegrino ((908) 756-4761; state directory email mpellegrino@southplainfieldnj.com). The state directory's smoke detector compliance block names 'South Plainfield Boro Constr' at 2480 Plainfield Av with phone (908) 226-7640, and the Borough's Building Department form issues the smoke/CO certification, so the Building Department is recorded as the issuing office. The Fire Marshal's web page lists no resale smoke certificate form. Fees are the same single certificate as in resale_co; only the main tiers are repeated here.
